scope: NO-ACTION activation prerequisites for the locally built direct-control image with native control support (measurement fe897820f632bae497511a229f0c74465dade8841d5807f8287a3a2caa928d22c8d79c24ffa9b1f9554434b483fae38f; 4 vCPUs, family 26 model 2 stepping 1, pinned OVMF 142589cc). Nothing here was executed. Source references are to commit 493ee9ee07497c94159ec4f6916e9ea920d31959. Adapted from measured-image-build/public/ACTIVATION-REQUIREMENTS.json (6f2c7da4); its relay-allowlist correction still holds.
relayAllowlist: NOT a prerequisite: a direct guest never attaches to the legacy fleet tunnel (metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:564 planDirectBoot refuses relayUrl/relayHost/tunnelToken/fleetSecret/certsApi/ACME inputs; metal/enclave-metal.mjs:176-191 refuses them for control "direct"). METAL_ALLOWED_MEASUREMENTS stays for legacy tunnel boxes only.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Owner direct config, bound by HOST_DATA
requiredForDirectControl.what: identity, contracts/rpcs/quorum, isolation endpoints, replicas, controlPort, hostAdmissionSha256 bound to the actual host wallet policy, plus the optional members platformApi / mcp / platformPolicyCarriers / leaseGas / ownerNomination / nativeControl. Any change = new HOST_DATA = relaunch.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Launch with the implemented launcher in direct mode
requiredForDirectControl.what: host config control:"direct", mode:"snp", direct:<canonical owner config>, dist:<this verified image>, the pinned OVMF, cpus 4 (the measured count; recompute for any other count or CPU signature), snp-guest-per-app isolation backend with release tickets off, only the control port forwarded, registryKeyFile 0600/0400 when selling. The lifecycle CLI --control-* flags are NOT implemented.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Trust lists that verify a direct guest carry THIS measurement (replacing bdadc7bb for the native-control image)
refs: metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:354-355 (platformApi.measurements: 1-8 digests, identical in every member config)
requiredForDirectControl.what: owner/client expectations, the Platform API group's measurements[] (all members on this image before any config carries the new members), hosted-MCP client expectations, and the native discovery service's NATIVE_CONTROL_MEASUREMENTS.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Admin CLI with AMD collateral (NOT the 493ee9ee copy)
refs: scripts/platform-api-admin.mjs:100 at 493ee9ee: productionVerifier({ config }) gets no collateral

source repo commits after 493ee9ee: 0eac0d60b 'Verify admin targets with AMD collateral and send packages only to the attested key', dfe020abf 'Let the admin tool's status command send its body-less GET'
requiredForDirectControl.what: genesis/handoff/credential packages must be produced with the admin CLI from root's reviewed later commit. Those commits touch no image input (post-check), so this image does not change; I did NOT review or test them.

refs: metal/guest/measured-control.mjs:467 (REGISTRY_ENABLED/CLAIM_ENABLED only with the operator key)
requiredForDirectControl.what: the operator funds registration and setProofKey (root, wallet action); verification stays 'pending' until the registry names the minted proof key

refs: supervisor.js:586-597, 5527 (policy gate; refusal on an admin ban)
network/native-control-routes.mjs:185 (chipId deny refuses an unproven chip)
requiredForDirectControl.what: admin AddressBook-anchored platform host policy enforced in every direct guest and at every native control route and native-issuer install barrier; registry/catalog/contract admin rights unchanged; the admin-signed policy document must be on real non-DigitalOcean carriers before any anchor.

requiredForDirectControl.item: Hardware launch and verification (root; not done)
requiredForDirectControl.what: verifyMeasuredControl with current AMD collateral (CRL), minimum TCB, config digest and this measurement must return 'verified' for each member; the hardware report is the final independent measurement check; then an owner-authorized deployment must be claimed and launched.
genesis with import of the old AUTH_DATA_DIR, then point api.enclave.host DNS and its WebPKI certificate at the members; rollback point = the old data directory

requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.item: nativeControl member in each serving member's bound config
requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.what: { names: sorted subset of [api.enclavehost.eth, mcp.enclavehost.eth], caSha256: sha256 of the existing native CA DER }; needs platformApi; names != platformApi.hostname. Changes HOST_DATA (relaunch).

requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.item: Native CA custody: either the platform API group issuer or the offline admin
refs: metal/guest/platform-api-role.mjs:143-144 (never in the relay child), :168-174 (primary only)
requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.what: group issuance is inactive until root adds NATIVE_CA_KEY/NATIVE_CA_CERT to an admin-signed credentials package sealed to the verified primary (credential handling = root). Without them, the offline admin fallback must issue each 7-day leaf over the attested key and install it; a native name with no current leaf fails its handshake.

requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.item: Native discovery deployment (NOT in this image)
refs: network/native-control-routes.mjs:258-269 (NATIVE_CONTROL_SERVICE_INDEX, _RPCS 2-8, _QUORUM, _REGISTRY, _MEASUREMENTS, _EXCLUDE required = the DigitalOcean IPv4 failure domain)
requiredForNativeControlNames (optional;.what: deploy the 493ee9ee relay/native-discovery.mjs + network/native-control-routes.mjs where native discovery runs, with NATIVE_CONTROL_* configured (this measurement included); each serving operator publishes a kind-9 native-control ad in the pinned service index (operator signing/gas = root). Until then the control names answer 503 (fail-closed), not the old fixed DO addresses.
